reference.usage: geometry, hierarchy, color and material reference only. Never render this file as the website background.

designRead.backgroundCharacter: pure light canvas with restrained technical linework
designRead.primaryFocalPoint: vertical rocket anchored to the right edge

copy.supportingCopy: Acelere tráfego orgânico, leads qualificados e receita previsível com engenharia de dados e SEO técnico.

relations: The rocket must never intersect the bounding box of headline, supporting-copy or primary-cta. Its bounding box may occupy the navbar CTA region, as in the approved reference, only when the CTA remains fully painted above it and receives pointer input.
The primary CTA aligns to the left edge of the headline and supporting copy.
The headline dominates all other typography and remains fully visible.
The trajectory stays between conversion content and rocket.

componentRules.navbar: single desktop line; logo and all labels are semantic text; navbar CTA is filled amber with ink text.
componentRules.headline: Anton only; no gradient fill; no overlap; no more than two desktop lines.
componentRules.cta: filled #FFC552 rectangle with 4px radius, ink text, visible arrow affordance and no wrapping at desktop.
componentRules.rocket: use a verified client asset with a vertical silhouette, matte light and charcoal material, controlled amber details and an edge crop matching the reference. If no client asset can meet this, return a blocked result instead of substituting a generic rocket.
componentRules.trajectory: one amber curve and one vertical measured line with top and bottom endpoints only. No orbit circles, data cards, KPI counters, badges or decorative crosshairs.

desktop.rule: keep all six zones visible in the first viewport

mobile.rule: stack headline, copy, CTA, then rocket; no overlap or horizontal overflow

allowed: rocket parallax of 8px maximum on pointer-capable desktop
motion.reducedMotion: all continuous motion disabled and content remains visible
forbidden: motion that hides CTA or copy

antiDrift: Do not use generic bento cards or a dashboard.
Do not add a second image, photo orbit or badge cluster to the hero.
Do not change any approved copy.
Do not use the golden raster as a visual implementation shortcut.

failurePolicy: Any P0 violation is a failed task result. The executor must report the violating selector, screenshot and measured value.
